Risk_Description: Contact details could leak onto public screens as new screens are added in Sprints 1-2
Mitigation_Action: RSU email is the only contact channel and appears only after mutual accept; public-screen scan repeated at Labs 08, 13 and final release - no identifiers on any public screen

Risk_Description: Free-text pickup area or listing photos could reveal private info (room numbers; faces; room backgrounds)
Mitigation_Action: Pickup area is a fixed campus-zone dropdown; item-only photo rule stated on the sell form

Risk_Description: Verification process could drift into storing ID numbers or images creating real PDPA exposure
Mitigation_Action: Verification stayed an in-person visual check storing a boolean flag only; no ID data anywhere in the final build

Risk_Description: Listing title and pickup area rendered via innerHTML - typed HTML/script executes on render (stored XSS pattern)
Mitigation_Action: textContent rendering shipped in v0.2 and regression-tested at every release incl. v1.0

Risk_Description: Admin actions not separated - anyone in the demo browser could change status or remove listings
Mitigation_Action: Separate labelled Admin view (demo) shipped; seller status control moved to My Listings in v0.3

Risk_Description: Meet-safely tagline plus verified badge may overpromise safety while verification is simulated in the demo
Mitigation_Action: Safer-meetups wording and simulated-verification labels shipped; landing page copy follows the same rule

Risk_Description: Users do not understand what happens after a contact request (2/5 in Lab 08) and misread Reserved status
Mitigation_Action: What-happens-next explainer and Reserved wording shipped; verified in Lab 13 (contact flow 4/5 vs 2/5; Reserved 5/5)

Risk_Description: Icons stock images or snippets could be added without license records during Sprints 1-2 and Lab 12 landing page
Mitigation_Action: Register-first rule held: final IP register shows zero third-party assets; AI documentation assistance disclosed

Risk_Description: localStorage is per-browser and wipeable causing inconsistent demo data; duplicate listings possible
Mitigation_Action: Seed self-heal + reset button; duplicate-listing confirm dialog shipped in v1.0
